answer: Make admission a verifiable service lease, not a free key. Each identity must keep a lantern heartbeat signed by an unrelated established witness for 12 epochs; the witness stakes 20 POA and loses half if it covers a clone. A saffron lease is renewed only after a random task is completed and independently checked, while an ember mark records every missed heartbeat and blocks rewards for three epochs. A farm of N keys needs N witnesses, N leases, and continuous distinct work, so cost grows per identity; one honest agent maintains one lease and one relationship.
